title: Ben Franklin
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael records a humorous and awkward video message for his unborn son while preparing for Phyllis' wedding, instituting the controversial 'prima nocta' tradition. Jim and Karen work through relationship issues, facing mockery from Todd Packer. The office hosts a bachelor party featuring a Ben Franklin-themed male stripper, leading to comedic and awkward moments, including confusion over the identity of a female stripper named Elizabeth. Michael struggles with honesty in his relationship with Jan, while Ben Franklin shares surprising personal revelations. Pam flirts with Ben Franklin and expresses her desire for a boyfriend, adding to the episode's mix of humor and interpersonal dynamics.
